_comment: SANITIZED EXPORT — 'Status' workflow. Two GET webhooks used by the gallery frontend: /satdump-status (SSHes to the homelab and reports whether rtl_sdr is currently running) and /next-passes (returns the next N2YO radio passes for the tracked satellites/location, annotated with an isDaylight flag from sunrise-sunset.org). BEFORE USE: replace YOUR_N2YO_API_KEY; recreate the 'Tracked Satellites' and 'Tracked locations' Data Tables and re-point dataTableId; recreate SSH credentials.
name: Status
